MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ellen Chaitin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, Reporter: B. Fields, CSR #7235

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. special appeared for plaintiffs Chase Bank USA, N.A., a corp.,
Plaintiff's Witness: Sheri Gorman was placed under oath and direct examined.
Default has been entered against the defendant.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff, and against the Defaulted Defendant Artour V. Katanski for Judgment as follows:

Damages - $106,074.09
Prejudgment Interest - $5,201.99
Attorney's Fees - NONE
Costs - $268.00
Total judgment in the amount of $111,544.08
Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
